Package dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml

Record Class SamlPrincipal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml.SamlPrincipal
Record Components:
idp - the SamlIdp.id()
issuer - the provider's entity ID
nameId - as the provider sent it, which logging out must repeat exactly; null when it sent none
sessionIndex - the provider's session, for logging out of it
attributes - every attribute by its Name, values in order
All Implemented Interfaces:
Principal
public record SamlPrincipal(String idp, String issuer, String name, SamlPrincipal.NameId nameId, String sessionIndex, Map<String,List<String>> attributes) extends Record implements Principal
A user a SAML identity provider vouched for. name() is the pairwise-id, else the subject-id, else the NameID (SAML2Int SDP-SP14): unique per issuer(), never across issuers.
